Reading scanned and digital documents with OCR and vision models into structured, checked fields.

The concept behind it: [Information extraction](@/glossary/information-extraction.md).

Services that draw on it: [Decision support and AI agents for analysts](@/services/decision-support-ai.md).

Practised with: [HTML](@/glossary/html.md), [JavaScript](@/glossary/javascript.md), [Python](@/glossary/python.md), [Alpine.js](@/glossary/alpine-js.md), [Claude API](@/glossary/claude-api.md), [Dockerfile](@/glossary/dockerfile.md), [FastAPI](@/glossary/fastapi.md) and [Flowbite Pro](@/glossary/flowbite-pro.md).

Public work whose own words show it: [data-atlas](https://github.com/korczis/data-atlas).

It was applied in client work in Real-estate developer; the use cases below give the principle and the intent, without names or numbers.

How to read this page: the definition is the experience vocabulary's; the services, technologies, public [repositories](@/glossary/repository.md) and use cases are derived and each links to its page.
